The main guidance document is for:

school leaders

school staff

It applies to all schools and may also be useful for further education and community settings.

Preventing and tackling bullying and harassment of school staff is guidance to help schools protect and support their staff.

The advice for parents and carers is designed to help them prevent and respond to cyber bullying aimed at children and young people in their care.
